narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating obligated $916M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. American Centrifuge Operating received 2 awards, with an average award size of $458M, and obligations were up 361.8% year over year. Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing is the largest market for American Centrifuge Operating, accounting for $900M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Nuclear Electric Power Generation accounted for $15.9M of obligations. FY2026 to date is a partial fiscal-year total, following prior-year obligations of $198M in FY25, $85M in FY24, $50M in FY23, $42.9M in FY22, and $38.9M in FY21.
